why: Shell cycle 2 (docs/v3/cycles/shell-2.md, P1 shell-2.1): a selection's crumb parent, the documented way up from a SplitPage selection (`<PageBar parent={{ label, href }} />`, app-shell.md), has no working form. The shell draws the bar's `PageCrumb` element as is (`src/shell/app-shell.tsx:185-195`). `PageCrumb` (`src/page/page-bar.tsx:40-47`) renders a string `href` as a bare `<a>`, so a click reloads the whole document under an installed `BasaltProvider link` and drops the page's other search params. It renders a `NavTarget`, which `src/page/contract.ts:77` types, as a `<span>` with no link (`.evidence/cycle-shell-2/parent.log`, `parent-navtarget.log`). Its JSDoc says the shell draws the crumb with its own link adapter; nothing does. P3 shell-2.6 rides along: app-shell.md says a phone shows no ancestors, but the phone header shows the page's parent beside the SplitPage back link.
what: A crumb parent is an in-app link in both forms, and the phone crumb rule is one rule in docs and code.
change: `PageCrumb` renders the parent through `AppLink` (the provider's link) for a string and a `NavTarget` alike, as the bar's own trail already does (`page-bar.tsx:338`); its JSDoc says what it does. `app-shell.md` shows the `NavTarget` form that keeps the page's params and clears the selection: `navTarget({ to, ...field.link('') })`. Check that form clears the field before documenting it. For shell-2.6, pick one rule: hide the page's parent at `compact`, where the SplitPage back link is the way back, or document that a phone keeps the parent and drops the section. Make app-shell.md and app-shell.tsx agree.
commits: fix: commits in packages/basalt-ui, granular (crumb link, phone rule).
proof: make check; a layout test clicks a crumb parent and finds the document kept and the other search params in the URL; a test renders a NavTarget parent as a link.
acceptance: A string and a NavTarget crumb parent both render as links through the provider's link; a click keeps the document (layout test)
The documented NavTarget form keeps the page's other params and clears the selection (test)
app-shell.md and the compact crumb agree on whether a phone shows the page's parent
out_of_scope: Focus after a SplitPage swap and the other shell P3s (v3-shell-2-shell).
